$comment: Whether a line came from a server or from a person, shared by tests/shared/source.test.ts and the Android SharedCorpusTest. A private message is filed under whoever sent it, which is right until the sender is not a who: Rizon's notices arrive from irc.rizon.life, and both clients opened a conversation with a person of that name and gave it an unread badge.
$cases: `prefix` is the message's source. `server` is whether it belongs in the console rather than in a conversation.

cases.name: a person, with a full mask
a service, which is someone you talk to
a service with no mask is still someone
another server on the same network
a server before it has told us its name
no prefix at all is the server we are talking to
a nick that merely contains a dot in the host part
